description: Investra connects your real estate investment workflow to your AI assistant. Search and evaluate property listings, run investment analyses, review projected returns and cash flow, and share investor-ready reports — all from chat. The integration uses the same data, permissions, and plan limits as the Investra web app, so anything done through the assistant matches what you'd see in your account. Built for real estate professionals who want to spend less time on manual analysis and more time advising on deals and closing them.
